column3: Enhanced Tile Visibility
column4: Added an optional stronger native tile-shading setting while preserving the original terrain art and visual preference.

column3: Automatic Stair Navigation
column4: Added normal walking routes to discovered upstairs and downstairs, stopping at the destination without changing floors.

column3: Safe stair movement
column4: Stair navigation stops for enemies, damage, blocked routes and known hazards; ordinary movement remains unchanged.

column3: Compact stair controls
column4: Added one native staircase control with Up and Down choices alongside the existing dungeon controls.

column3: Known stair highlight
column4: Selecting discovered stairs briefly highlights their exact tile without exposing undiscovered terrain or replacing combat warnings.

column3: Saved accessibility choices
column4: Added persistent Enhanced Tile Visibility and Automatic Stair Navigation choices, both off by default.

column3: Android travel and visibility
column4: Added real-touch stair-menu checks, travel and interruption checks, save/reload checks and original/enhanced screenshots at two zoom levels.

column3: Cleric and stair layout
column4: Extended Android overlap checks to include the stair control alongside all four Cleric spell buttons.

column3: Android visual evidence
column4: Added six required gameplay screenshots to the artifact checks alongside the existing five history comparisons.

column3: Verified private staging
column4: Staged the tested preceding APK with exact signer, checksum, source and test evidence before preparing the new features.

column3: Current verification record
column4: Updated the shared handoff, reports and full build request, including the blocked TEST71 attempt without an APK.

column3: Original Visuals And Existing Controls Are The Defaults
column4: Added a check that both new options preserve the original visuals and controls by default.

column3: Both Options Persist Across Preference Reload
column4: Added a check that both choices remain saved across preference reloads.

column3: Turning Enhancement Off Preserves The Original Grid Choice
column4: Added a check that disabling tile enhancement restores the player's original visual-grid choice.

column3: Damage Cancels Even When Normal Damage Interruption Was Disabled
column4: Added a regression check that taking damage cancels stair travel even when ordinary damage interruption was disabled.

column3: Restored Hero Does Not Resume Transient Navigation
column4: Added a save regression check that the hero's position and health survive reload without restarting transient stair travel.

column3: Walking Pays The Normal Movement Cost Without Changing Floors
column4: Added a real movement check for normal turn cost and unchanged floor depth.

column3: Offscreen And Obscured Known Stairs Still Have Exact Destinations
column4: Added a check that known stairs outside the current field of view remain valid destinations while unknown stairs remain concealed.

column3: Both Directions Choose Only Their Own Stair
column4: Added a check that upstairs and downstairs resolve to their corresponding destinations.

column3: Undiscovered Stair Does Not Expose Its Location
column4: Added a check that undiscovered stairs cannot expose a destination.

column3: Mapped Stairs Are Already Known
column4: Added a check that previously mapped stairs count as discovered.

column3: Missing Direction Cannot Fall Back To Other Stair
column4: Added a check that a missing staircase cannot silently select the opposite direction.

column3: Known Traps And Pits Are Unsafe But Secret Traps Are Not Revealed
column4: Added a check that known active traps and pits are avoided without revealing secret traps.

column3: Blocked Avoided And Unknown Tiles Are Unsafe
column4: Added a check that blocked, unsafe and unexplored tiles cannot enter a stair route.

column3: Visible Fire Is Unsafe Without Revealing Unseen Gas
column4: Added a check that visible environmental danger blocks travel without exposing unseen effects.

column3: Enemy Prevents Navigation Without Using A Turn
column4: Added a check that a visible enemy prevents stair travel without consuming a turn.

column3: Normal Move Is Selected Instead Of Floor Transition
column4: Added a check that selecting stairs creates a normal movement action instead of a floor-transition action.

column3: Manual Cancellation Cannot Resume A Stale Stair Route
column4: Added a check that cancelled stair travel cannot be resumed as a stale route.

column3: Blocked Stair Has No Route
column4: Added a check that blocked stairs return an unavailable-route message.

column3: Navigation Does Not Consume Randomness Or Change Terrain
column4: Added a check that selecting a stair route leaves gameplay randomness and terrain unchanged.

column3: Developer Commentary
column4: I added optional tile contrast and a shortcut for walking to known stairs. Both preserve ordinary game turns and saves, with new checks for interruption, layout and visual behavior.
